title: Five cyclic fields with accelerated cubes, full-anchor budgets, and order-averaged ties

claims.statement: The explicit 5-field degree-200 cyclic encoder with extended quadratic-residue parity and its radius-200 depth-budget list decoder on 2000 BSC(1/10) uses have average block error at most 5525068598697120996095173661607/100000000000000000000000000000000.
The same bsc-ops-v1 decoder executes at most W=207892133409958014270091786997479918434818842135225308111311440134006576 primitives on every received word, with W<=2^(4237658/17887).

experiments.purpose: Check QR and field geometry, accelerated cube, positions and exact work (0), pair bounds 198–219 (1), pair bounds 220–238 and 239 child weights (2), and the order-averaged occupancy bound (3).
